newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - St George says may make pref issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - St George says may make pref issue.

text.p: St George Bank Ltd may use another issue of converting preference shares to help fund its merger with Advance Bank Australia Ltd, St George managing director Jim Sweeney said on Monday.
"One wouldn't discount a further CPS (converting preference share) issue," Sweeney told a news conference.
He had been asked what form the bank's announced capital raising of up to A$360 million to fund the merger would take.

Earlier St George announced it would bid an effective A$7.30 per share for Advance, including A$2.10 in cash, a 20 cent special cash dividend and new St George shares up to a value of A$5.00 per Advance Bank share.
St George said with the announcement it would raise A$360 million to help fund the bid, but did not say what form the capital raising would take.
It said the capital raising would proceed upon completion of the acquisition, expected to be in April.
St George completed in May a A$360 million converting preference share issue to fund its eventually unsuccessful takeover bid for Metway Bank Ltd.
